text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am bored. By royal decree, speak of 
something. I grant you the honor of 
entertaining your King.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-No way! Not out of nowhere like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright, I got it! Something funny... 
something funny...—Ah!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday in the cafeteria, Nakayama-san 
did something—!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indulging in reckless gambles, were we? 
Let me guess, Russian roulette or 
something of the sort... No?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Uh... ah... you're not wrong, sir... Umm, 
well then, Golshi-san did something the 
day before yesterday—!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You were probably acting bizarrely. Let's 
see, were you carrying around a tuna or an 
octopus, perhaps...? Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: You're not wrong, sir... It's both...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...You're setting the bar way too high for 
meee!
